decision.reason: E2 showed the semantic pattern is useful but observer identity and sampling cannot be canonical; E3 reproduced identity/privacy invariants; E4 showed the thin receipt-ref shape dominates full-field projection in both local JSON and actual OTel 1.42.1 OTLP protobuf serialization.

proposed_delta.name: F2_NONAUTHORITATIVE_OPENINFERENCE_RECEIPT_PROJECTION/v1
proposed_delta.flow: immutable admitted F2 receipt/runpackage -> pure allowlisted projection -> OpenInference-compatible evaluator/span metadata -> optional observer exporter
observer_fields: exactly one post-hoc target Span Link where a target observer span exists

measured_evidence.e3_invariants: 30/30 PASS at deterministic local JSON fixture scope

counterhypotheses: F2 native receipts plus existing telemetry are already sufficiently searchable, so even a thin compatibility projection may add maintenance burden without workflow value.
The local serialization advantage may disappear once exporter, batch processor, collector, network and storage/query costs are included.
A stable F2-native observer schema may be preferable to tracking OpenInference semantic-convention evolution.
Post-hoc Span Links may improve visualization but add no decision-relevant information beyond canonical receipt refs.
acceptance_gates: Projection is a pure one-way function over an already-admitted immutable F2 evidence object/ref; source object remains unchanged.
Canonical F2 receipt ref and SHA-256 are copied exactly and remain primary; observer trace/span IDs never replace them.
Sensitive prompt/output/tool definition/secrets/free-form metadata are absent by default under a fail-closed allowlist before sampling/export.
Observer-disabled or sampled/suppressed telemetry cannot create negative evidence about the underlying F2 event.
Malformed canonical digest, unsupported authority claim, or ambiguous receipt identity fails closed.
No reverse adapter writes to UnifiedDB, GWT uptake/re-entry state, effects, completion, goals or world truth.
Repository-hosted tests compare thin projection with no-projection/native baseline and preserve bounded overhead.
If OpenTelemetry is used, exactly one intended post-hoc Span Link is preserved and OTLP serialization tests remain deterministic at the declared semantic level.
rollback_or_reject: Reject if the adapter requires full OpenInference framework/provider instrumentor adoption for the target use case.
Reject if any observer ID becomes an input to canonical identity, completion or causal influence decisions.
Reject if privacy requires a denylist rather than a positive export allowlist.
Reject if Trigger-4 measurement finds no material inspection/query benefit versus native receipts after integration cost.
Reject or keep disabled-by-default if bounded overhead cannot be demonstrated in the actual F2 telemetry path.
